label: late-episode rewarded D1 (end-of-episode clock gated by reward input)
explanation: Fires only at D1 steps where the reward input is 1 (previous trial rewarded), and only late in the episode: 0 activations before trial 70, 7% of mass in trials 80-89, 95% in trials 90-99. Never fires at GO or D2, on unrewarded D1s, or before trial ~80. It looks like an internal episode-length clock that is read out only when a reward arrives; value is correspondingly low (97% of mass in the lowest value bin, as the value head anticipates the episode end). Choice, state, transition, stay/switch and the good state carry no clear signal. Onset is soft: an ep_trial threshold of 93 trades precision (0.64) against recall (0.83, mass 0.86); >=90 gives recall 0.93 / precision 0.46, >=95 gives precision 0.78 / recall 0.66. Activations at trial >=98 have precision 0.91 but are not the largest by mass. Only observed variables (reward input, trial count) are used.
